summary: Washington University School of Medicine is sponsoring a clinical trial to test a drug called Semaglutide for people who have long-lasting low back pain and obesity, which means having a high amount of body fat. The study aims to enroll 250 participants between the ages of 18 and 85. Currently, the trial status is Not yet recruiting. Participants will receive either Semaglutide or an inactive substance called a placebo using a special pen-injector.
